rationale: Confirmed against source: visited.add occurs in the same branch as queue.put, so every reachable vertex is enqueued once at most. Every reachable adjacency entry is scanned once; time O(V + E), space O(V), and the queue holds at most V vertices.

Confirmed against source: the full (m+1) by (n+1) table is allocated and every cell is filled, including boundaries for empty strings. Time and space are O((m+1)(k+1)), worst case O(N^2). For the label, k = len(word2); the code names the second length n.

Confirmed against source: the KMP scan and computePrefixFunction are amortized linear; pi uses O(k) space, excluding returned matches. For the label, k = needle.length; the code names it n. After a full match, q resets below n, keeping needle.charAt(q) in bounds.

Confirmed against source: one pass with scalar state gives O(n) time and O(1) space. The final predictedAnswer comparison is constant work. The non-empty assumption is required because the code reads a[0].

Confirmed against source: left only moves forward, so the scan is O(n) expected time with expected O(1) dictionary operations. The map holds at most U distinct characters, so auxiliary space is O(U), U <= n. Type checking and the empty-string guard are O(1).
